Browse Moagram stealthily without broadcasting your online status, typing indicators, or read receipts.
Do not announce your online presence to Moagram. You appear offline while continuing to receive live online updates of other users.
Do not send \'typing...\' or recording indicators when replying to chats.
Messages are marked as read only on this device. Senders will continue to see them as unread.
Automatically mark messages in a chat as read only when you send a reply in that chat.
View stories without appearing in the story viewers list.

Mark messages and saves as background traffic and immediately restore offline status, preventing Moagram from updating your Last Seen or broadcasting you online while keeping other people\'s online status visible.

Note: Moagram servers normally update your last seen when you send a message. Ghost Mode flags outgoing messages as background traffic and immediately sends an offline status packet to keep you appearing offline while still seeing others online.
Allow saving media to gallery, copying text, taking screenshots, and forwarding messages from channels and groups that restrict content saving.
Keep messages that were deleted by other users or administrators in your chats.
Retain photos, videos, and files from deleted messages in local cache instead of wiping them.

Prevent self-destructing and view-once photos, videos, and voice messages from expiring or being deleted after viewing.

Moagram keeps the next 7 occurrences queued, including while the app is closed. Missed times are skipped. Deleting an occurrence skips it; use Manage Repeats to stop the series.
Open Manage Repeats and tap Retry.

Stopping this repeat. Queued occurrences will be removed when Moagram connects to Telegram.
Stop this repeat and remove its upcoming queued messages? Messages already sent will remain.

Free repeats support single text messages, photos, videos, files, stickers, contacts, locations and single forwarded messages. Paid messages, rich articles, polls, albums, self-destructing media and other special message types are not supported. Choose Never to schedule once.
